PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the City Council or any of its Agencies listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed five (5) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por cinco (5) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.

minutes_text:
CITY COUNCIL
MINUTES
CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
CITY COUNCIL
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 03, 2008
7:00 p.m. COUNCIL CHAMBERS
14403 E. Pacific Avenue
Baldwin Park
Manuel Lozano, Mayor
Anthony J. Bejarano, Mayor Pro Tem Marlen Garcia, Monica Garcia, Ricardo Pacheco, Council Members
Maria Contreras, City Treasurer Susan Rubio, City Clerk
The CITY COUNCIL of the City of Baldwin Park met in REGULAR SESSION at the above time and place.
CALL TO ORDER
INVOCATION
Led by Pastor Jackson
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
Present: Council member Marlen Garcia, Council member Pacheco, Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano, Mayor Lozano.
Absent: None.
Also Present: City Attorney Joseph W. Pannone, Director of Recreation & Community Services Manuel Carrillo Jr., Community Development Manager Marc Castagnola, Director of Public Works William Galvez, Chief of Police Lili Hadsell, City Treasurer Contreras, City Clerk Rubio, Deputy City Clerk Nieto.
Council member Monica Garcia arrived at 6:07 p.m.
ANNOUNCEMENTS
Mayor Lozano announced the Baldwin Park’s flag has been flown in Iraq by Marine Corporal Everett Marquez
PROCLAMATIONS, COMMENDATIONS & PRESENTATIONS
NONE
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
Greg Tuttle , business owner complimented the Police Department for the Coffee with the Cops event and City Attorney Pannone on the recent AB1234 training he conducted. He filed with the city clerk a public records request for any answers filed regarding the recall attempt.
He further inquired about funds still owed to the city from Bisno Development. He also requested a translator and on the CARA suit that was filed by Silverstein.
Vicky , resident inquired about her holiday lights and expressed concern about the ordinance regarding decorations. Mayor Lozano directed her to Community Development Manager Castagnola
Thomas Carey , resident spoke about gift cards and the current economic situation in the country
Tony Mena , resident spoke about his support of the proposed redevelopment project for the downtown.
Cruz Sembello , resident wished all a happy Thanksgiving and spoke about her hopes for the revitalization of the downtown. She expressed her desire for the Council and the residents to work together on a new project.
Public Communications were closed at 7:24 p.m.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Motion: Approve CONSENT CALENDAR
Moved by Mayor Lozano, seconded by Council member Pacheco.
1. WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
City Council received and filed.
2. PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL FOR THE PERIOD OF NOVEMBER 19, 2008 THROUGH DECEMBER 2, 2008
City Council approved the preparation and presentation of the plaques, certificates and proclamations as outlined in the report.
Staff Report
3. MINUTES
City Council approved the minutes of the special and regular meetings of November 19, 2008.
Staff Report
4. CLAIM REJECTIONS
City Council rejected the claims of Julian Cardenas, Marissa Carrillo, Misty Salinas, Ricardo Gonzalez and Clemente Coronado and directed staff to send the appropriate notices of rejection to the claimants.
Staff Report
5. CITY TREASURER’S REPORT - SEPTEMBER 2008
City Council received and filed.
Staff Report
CITY COUNCIL/ CITY CLERK / CITY TREASURER / STAFF REQUESTS & COMMUNICATIONS
Council member Monica Garcia requested that staff bring forward a reso in support of "Day Without a Bag." Council member Marlen Garcia expressed her support of this item.
Council member Pacheco invited the community to the Christmas Lighting ceremony at Morgan Park. He further inquired about the ordinance regarding holiday decorations. Community Development Manager Castagnola provided additional information.
Council member Marlen Garcia wished Mayor Lozano a happy birthday and announced Congresswoman Solis’ annual toy drive in West Covina at Cameron Park.
Council member Monica Garcia announced an upcoming food basket program
ADJOURNMENT
There being no other matters for discussion the meeting was adjourned at 7:30 p.m.
Approved as presented by the Council at their meeting held December 17, 2008.
Laura M. Nieto
Deputy City Clerk
